It corroborates control role/location only; it does not show the pause transition, and it is not v1.0.2 pixel-parity evidence. evidence_note.logic_evidence: In original dqhud_droid.swf sprite756 FRAME 0, the menu onShow bytecode at offsets 0x28979..0x2898c unconditionally sets this.buttons.btn_Debug._visible=false. The same onShow handler localizes Continue/Help/Multiplayer/Options/Main Menu, chooses Single or Multi from NativeIsMultiplayerGame, and plays the authored Idle timeline. The page button actions and confirmation Yes/No routes are retained in native_action_flow above.
evidence_note.admission_and_visibility_gates: Pause page is selected at source show stop frame14; the unconditional onShow visibility assignment excludes the whole btn_Debug branch, including its default BtnText field and hit contour. Source Cheats do not become substitute controls: their fill alpha composes to zero in the exported source frame. Multiplayer is included only on the authored Multi frame. The helper creates no menu state, pause/audio side effects, or application-exit behavior.
